name: btc-5m-binary-trustwallet-bnb
_note_volatility: volatility_regime is deliberately absent. Its floor exists to make sure a move clears the spread you cross, and on a yes/no contract you cross no spread: any non-zero move resolves the bet. Measured over 1,042 unseen days, accuracy either side of the band is the same (57.9% below the floor, 58.2% inside, 57.1% above the ceiling), so the gate only threw signals away. Extreme volatility is still handled, by risk.atr_shock_rank, which is where a tail guard belongs.
